questions.question: Explain why the interior angles of a quadrilateral add to 360 degrees.
questions.expected_answer: A diagonal divides the quadrilateral into two triangles. The angles of each triangle add to 180, and the six triangle angles together make up exactly the four angles of the quadrilateral, two of which the diagonal splits. So the total is 180 plus 180, which is 360.

questions.question: One angle of a parallelogram is 70 degrees. Find the others with reasons.
questions.expected_answer: The opposite angle is 70, opposite angles of a parallelogram. Each adjacent angle is co-interior with the 70 between the parallel sides, so it is 180 minus 70, which is 110. The angles are 70, 110, 70 and 110, adding to 360.

questions.question: Why are the opposite angles of a parallelogram equal?
questions.expected_answer: Each pair of adjacent angles is co-interior between a pair of parallel sides and so adds to 180. Two opposite angles are therefore each equal to 180 minus the same angle between them, so they are equal to each other.
